perks.name: Battle Surge
perks.effect: Breaking an enemy's shield boosts sprint and reload speed.

perks.name: Stowed Reload
perks.effect: Stowed weapons reload automatically after a short delay.

perks.name: Trailblazer
perks.effect: Allies get a speed boost when running toward you from long distances.

perks.name: Care Package Insight
perks.effect: Reveals a care package's contents, including its best item.

perks.name: Charged Knock
perks.effect: Restores health and shields on a knock.

perks.name: Survey Beacons
perks.effect: Scanning a Survey Beacon briefly reveals nearby enemy positions.

perks.name: Threat Vision
perks.effect: Threat vision while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Revive Expert
perks.effect: Faster revives (not D.O.C.), revives provide health regen. Banner crafting & ally deathboxes spawn Mobile Respawn Beacon

perks.name: Ring Consoles
perks.effect: Reveals the next ring; activating one again lets you call an EVAC.

perks.name: Reinforce Hardlight
perks.effect: Reinforce or rebuild Hardlight meshes to fortify an area.

perks.name: Zone Overcharge
perks.effect: +25 shield capacity and slow shield regen while inside the safe zone.

legends.name: Ash

kit.passive: A dash.
kit.tactical: Arc Snare: spinning snare that tethers the nearest enemy.
kit.ultimate: Phase Breach: one-way portal to a targeted spot.

strengths: Lots of opportunity to outplay with dash
Death box info leads you straight to weakened fights.
Snare plus portal is a strong dive.
weaknesses: Portal is one-way, so a bad dive can't be undone.
Little to offer when holding position.

legends.name: Ballistic

kit.passive: The Sling: stores a third weapon.
kit.tactical: Whistler: overheats an enemy's gun if they keep firing.
kit.ultimate: Tempest: nearby allies get speed, faster reloads and infinite ammo.

strengths: Tempest is a strong team-wide push buff.
A third gun covers every range.
weaknesses: No escape or team movement.
Whistler is easy to play around once spotted.

legends.name: Bangalore

kit.passive: Double Time: speed boost when shot at while sprinting.
kit.tactical: Smoke Launcher: canister that forms a smoke wall.
kit.ultimate: Rolling Thunder: creeping artillery strike.

strengths: Smoke wins revives, resets and crossings over open ground.
Ult forces teams out of cover and breaks up pushes.
weaknesses: Smoke blinds your own team too.
No team movement or intel.
Ult can wreck your own push.

legends.name: Fuse

kit.passive: Grenadier: extra grenades per slot; throws are faster and further.
kit.tactical: Knuckle Cluster: cluster bomb of airburst explosives.
kit.ultimate: Piercing shot that sprays smaller explosives where it lands. Alternate fire breaches buildings

strengths: Constant ability poke softens teams before a push.
Great at flushing campers out of cover.
New rocketjump is awesome
weaknesses: Tac damage is attritional, not bursty - it needs follow-up.

legends.name: Mad Maggie

kit.passive: Highlights damaged enemies; moves faster with a shotgun out.
kit.tactical: Riot Drill: burns through obstacles at enemies behind cover.
kit.ultimate: Wrecking Ball: drops speed pads and detonates near enemies.

strengths: Drill denies cover, including Gibby domes and doors.
Wrecking Ball gives the whole team speed for a push.
weaknesses: Very little defensive utility.
Wants close range, so she struggles in long-range fights.

legends.name: Alter

kit.passive: Gift from the Rift: sees and takes items from death boxes through walls.
kit.tactical: Void Passage: portal through surfaces under 25m thick.
kit.ultimate: Void Nexus: point the squad can recall to.

strengths: Nexus is a guaranteed team escape.
Wall portals give surprise angles into or from buildings.
weaknesses: Nexus has to be set up before the fight, can be camped.
Void Passages can help and hinder.

legends.name: Axle

kit.passive: Drift: more speed and control while sliding.
kit.tactical: Nitro Gate: gate that gives anyone high-speed slides.
kit.ultimate: Kickstart: enemy-seeking drone that launches targets into the air.

strengths: Nitro Gate speeds up the whole team.
Kickstart knocks enemies out of cover and out of position.
weaknesses: Gate can become a fast lane for enemies.
No intel or sustain.

legends.name: Horizon

kit.passive: Spacewalk: better air control and less fall damage.
kit.tactical: Gravity Lift: lifts the team vertically.
kit.ultimate: Black Hole: pulls enemies together.

strengths: Lift reaches height or gives a quick reset.
Black Hole groups enemies up for grenades and AoE.
weaknesses: Players on the lift are an easy target.
Ult is much weaker without AoE damage to follow it up.

legends.name: Octane

kit.passive: Swift Mend: automatic health regen.
kit.tactical: Stim: faster movement at a health cost.
kit.ultimate: Launch Pad: jump pad that launches teammates.

strengths: Pad is a fast team push or escape.
Great at entry and grabbing third-party fights.
weaknesses: Easy to run in too far ahead of the team.
Little utility once the fight starts.

legends.name: Pathfinder

kit.passive: Insider Knowledge: scans survey beacons to reveal the next ring.
kit.tactical: Grappling Hook: two charges.
kit.ultimate: Zipline Gun: zipline everyone can use.

strengths: Zipline gets the team to height or out of trouble.
Grapple lets him reach any high ground.
weaknesses: Ziplines are loud and visible.
No intel or defensive utility.

legends.name: Revenant

kit.passive: Highlights nearby low-health enemies; faster crouch walk.
kit.tactical: Shadow Pounce: chargeable forward leap.
kit.ultimate: Forged Shadows: shroud that absorbs damage and regenerates.

strengths: Pounce plus shadows is a fast dive onto weak players.
Good at finishing knocked players.
weaknesses: Does almost nothing for the team as a whole.
A bad pounce leaves him exposed.

legends.name: Wraith

kit.passive: Voices from the Void: warns of danger.
kit.tactical: Into the Void: fast travel while immune to damage.
kit.ultimate: Dimensional Rift: portal between two points for 60s.

strengths: Portal is a flexible rotation, escape or flank.
Void makes her very hard to finish off.
weaknesses: Portal has to be planned ahead.
Enemies can follow you through it.

legends.name: Bloodhound

kit.passive: Tracker: sees enemy footprints; look at ravens to reveal nearby enemies.
kit.tactical: Eye of the Allfather: forward scan that reveals enemies.
kit.ultimate: Allfather's Cloak: dome device that cloaks anyone inside.

strengths: Regular scans tell the team exactly when to push.
Cloak dome lets you revive or reposition hidden.
weaknesses: Cloak hides enemies inside too.
No team movement.

legends.name: Crypto

kit.passive: Neurolink: marks enemies his drone spots within 30m.
kit.tactical: Surveillance Drone: aerial view.
kit.ultimate: Drone EMP: shield damage, slow and disables traps.

strengths: Safe, steady intel from a distance.
EMP is a strong opener and clears Wattson/Caustic setups, helpful when breaching.
weaknesses: Vulnerable while flying the drone.
No movement for the team.

legends.name: Seer

kit.passive: Heart Seeker: hears and sees nearby heartbeats while aiming down sights.
kit.tactical: Focus of Attention: micro-drones that reveal enemies through walls.
kit.ultimate: Exhibit: sphere that reveals enemies who move fast or fire.

strengths: Instant intel before and during a fight.
Exhibit makes enemy revives and heals very risky.
weaknesses: No mobility or escape.
Weaker when the fight is chaotic and spread out.

legends.name: Sparrow

kit.passive: Double jump, or launch up a wall.
kit.tactical: Tracker dart that reveals enemies in its line of sight.
kit.ultimate: Arrow that releases six damaging blasts and slows everyone nearby.

strengths: Intel without giving up personal mobility.
Ult denies an area and slows pushes.
weaknesses: Mobility is just for him.
Ult slows your own team too.

legends.name: Valkyrie

kit.passive: VTOL Jets: jetpack flight with refilling fuel.
kit.tactical: Missile Swarm: mini-rockets that stun.
kit.ultimate: Skyward Dive: skydive launch that allies can join.

strengths: Best long-distance team rotation in the game.
Ult doubles as an escape and as a scan of the area.
weaknesses: Ult landing spot is predictable and easy to punish.
Big target while flying.

legends.name: Vantage

kit.passive: Spotter's Lens: scouting through her eyepiece; tracking teams charges her ult.
kit.tactical: Echo Relocation: launches her toward her bat, Echo.
kit.ultimate: Sniper's Mark: mark that gives the team a damage bonus.

strengths: Long-range info and damage.
Good at punishing teams that are rotating.
weaknesses: Echo only moves her, not the team.
Weak up close.

legends.name: Conduit

kit.passive: Savior's Speed: speed burst when running to a teammate out of tactical range.
kit.tactical: Radiant Transfer: gives a teammate temporary shields (two charges).
kit.ultimate: Energy Barricade: shield-jamming devices that damage and slow.

strengths: Instant shields mid-fight win close trades.
Ult zones off an area and drains enemy shields.
weaknesses: Shields are temporary.
Shield transfer needs line of sight to the teammate.

legends.name: Gibraltar

kit.passive: Fortified + Gun Shield: shield while aiming down sights.
kit.tactical: Dome of Protection: dome that blocks attacks.
kit.ultimate: Defensive Bombardment: mortar strike on a marked position.

strengths: Dome makes revives and heals safe.
Bombardment forces teams to move.
weaknesses: Domes can trap your own team.
Big hitbox and no mobility.

legends.name: Lifeline

kit.passive: D.O.C. revives teammates; also has Combat Glide.
kit.tactical: D.O.C. Heal Drone: heals nearby allies.
kit.ultimate: Halo Shield: blocks bullets and speeds up healing inside.

strengths: Best sustain in the game.
D.O.C. revives keep you shooting while a teammate gets up.
weaknesses: Not much engage or damage.
No team movement.

legends.name: Loba

kit.passive: Eye for Quality: sees epic and legendary loot through walls.
kit.tactical: Burglar's Best Friend: Jump Drive bracelet teleport.
kit.ultimate: Black Market Boutique: pulls nearby loot into your inventory.

strengths: Black Market keeps the team stocked on heals, ammo and grenades.
Bracelet reaches height or escapes alone.
weaknesses: Little direct impact on fights.
Bracelet only moves her.

legends.name: Mirage

kit.passive: Cloaks automatically while using beacons or reviving.
kit.tactical: Psyche Out: holographic decoy.
kit.ultimate: Life of the Party: a team of decoys.

strengths: Cloaked revives are hard to stop.
Decoys bait shots and reveal where enemies are.
weaknesses: Decoys do nothing against experienced players.
Little hard utility.

legends.name: Newcastle

kit.passive: Fortified + Retrieve the Wounded: drags downed allies behind a Revive Shield.
kit.tactical: Mobile Shield: controllable drone with a moving shield.
kit.ultimate: Castle Wall: leap that builds a fortified stronghold.

strengths: Revives are safe even in the open.
Castle Wall gives instant cover, on a teammate or on enemies.
weaknesses: Big and slow.
Mobile Shield is easy to shoot down.

legends.name: Catalyst

kit.passive: Barricade: reinforces up to four doors.
kit.tactical: Piercing Spikes: ferrofluid patch that spikes near enemies.
kit.ultimate: Dark Veil: wall that slows and blinds enemies who pass through it.

strengths: Veil splits teams and buys time to reset or rotate.
Reinforced doors make buildings very safe.
weaknesses: Little damage or engage.
Veil can block your own push.

legends.name: Caustic

kit.passive: Fortified + Nox Vision: sees enemies inside his gas.
kit.tactical: Nox Gas Trap: canisters that release gas.
kit.ultimate: Nox Gas Grenade: blankets a large area in gas.

strengths: Holds a building like nothing else.
Gas slows pushes and reveals enemies to him.
weaknesses: Slow. You need to rotate early.
Weak in the open with nothing to anchor traps to.

legends.name: Rampart

kit.passive: Bigger mags and faster reloads with LMGs and the Minigun.
kit.tactical: Amped Cover: crouch wall that powers up into full cover.
kit.ultimate: Sheila: mounted minigun anyone can use.

strengths: Instant cover in open endgame circles.
Amped walls win long-range trades.
weaknesses: Walls break easily early in the match.
No escape.

legends.name: Wattson

kit.passive: Ultimate Accelerants fully charge her ultimate.
kit.tactical: Perimeter Security: electrified fences between nodes.
kit.ultimate: Interception Pylon: destroys ordnance and repairs shields.

strengths: Pylon shuts down grenade spam and Gibby/Fuse ults.
Fences control choke points for a long time.
weaknesses: Needs setup time.
No mobility.
